workout.name: Snowboard Prep Routine
workout.description: Daily 25-30 minute routine designed to reduce soreness and injury risk, with special focus on hips, knees, ankles, and single-leg strength.

activities.name: March in Place or Jumping Jacks
activities.description: Light cardio to get blood flowing. March in place with high knees or do jumping jacks at a comfortable pace.

activities.name: Hip Circles
activities.description: Stand on one leg, lift the other knee, and rotate your hip in circles. Do 10 in each direction, then switch legs.

activities.name: Ankle Circles
activities.description: Lift one foot and rotate your ankle in circles. Do 10 each direction per foot.

activities.name: Torso Rotations
activities.description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hands on hips or extended. Rotate your torso left and right, keeping hips stable.

activities.name: World's Greatest Stretch
activities.description: Lunge forward, place opposite hand on ground, rotate torso and reach toward sky. Hold briefly at the top of each rep.

activities.name: Figure-4 Stretch
activities.description: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over opposite knee, and pull the bottom leg toward your chest. Feel the stretch in your glute and hip.

activities.name: Hamstring Hip-Hinge Stretch
activities.description: Stand with one foot slightly forward, hinge at hips keeping back straight, feel stretch in back of extended leg.

activities.name: Calf Stretch (Straight Knee)
activities.description: Step one foot back, keep back leg straight and heel on ground. Lean forward into front leg to stretch the calf.

activities.name: Calf Stretch (Bent Knee)
activities.description: Same position as straight knee stretch, but bend the back knee slightly to target the soleus muscle deeper in the calf.

activities.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Stretch
activities.description: Kneel with one foot forward, knee over toes. Slowly push knee forward past toes while keeping heel down. Move slowly and controlled.

activities.name: Cat-Cow
activities.description: On hands and knees, alternate between arching back up (cat) and dropping belly down (cow). Move slowly and breathe deeply.

activities.name: Single-Leg Balance
activities.description: Stand on one leg, keep core engaged. For more challenge, close your eyes or stand on an unstable surface.

activities.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
activities.description: Stand on one leg, hinge forward at hips while extending other leg behind. Keep back straight and return to standing.

activities.name: Split Squats
activities.description: Stand in a split stance with one foot forward. Lower back knee toward ground, then push back up. Keep front knee over ankle.

activities.name: Glute Bridges
activities.description: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat. Push through heels to lift hips toward ceiling, squeeze glutes at top.

activities.name: Dead Bug
activities.description: Lie on back, arms extended up, knees at 90 degrees. Slowly lower opposite arm and leg while keeping lower back pressed to floor.

activities.name: Side Plank
activities.description: Lie on side, prop up on elbow, lift hips to create straight line from head to feet. Keep core tight.

activities.name: Deep Squat Hold
activities.description: Squat down as deep as comfortable with heels on ground if possible. Hold and breathe. Use support if needed.

activities.name: Gentle Spinal Twist
activities.description: Lie on back, bring one knee across body while keeping shoulders flat. Look opposite direction and relax into the stretch.
